segments: Prime the teleporter, find four active wisps, teleport to the past, then repeat once more later in the quest.
Shoot all six teleporter prongs with the base Wrath of the Ancients until they glow orange/gold.
Use an upgraded bow to shoot the active wisp object.
The wisp moves after every hit. Find four total before the timer expires.
After the fourth hit, the teleporter turns purple. Send the team through together.
If the cycle fails, wait for the next round and prime the teleporter again.
Phone on the table in front of the Quick Revive side of spawn.
Front wheel / tire of the broken car on the route toward Double Tap.
Cabinet / box in the room above Double Tap.
Globe in the bedroom / study area past Samantha’s room.
Phone in the Power Switch room.
Clock above / near the dragon in Mission Control.
Radio / machinery object on the lower floor of Mission Control.
Clock on the upstairs route out of the courtyard toward the Clock Tower.
Memorize the three safe symbols top-to-bottom.
Use the past-lab interaction to open the Keeper Stone case.
Collect the Keeper Stone before you are returned.
